hypothesis: In SOLUSDT 4h SIDEWAYS_LOW contexts, a Donchian false breakout that closes back inside the prior range has positive net expectancy when faded over a maximum 24-hour horizon, after fixed execution-cost proxy and historical funding.

context.name: SIDEWAYS_LOW
context.classification: SHOCK if abs return > q99; else SIDEWAYS if abs EMA spread <= q30; volatility LOW if ATR/close <= q33; strategy eligible only if SIDEWAYS_LOW and not SHOCK

strategy.upperFailure: current high > max(previous N highs) and current close < prior channel high => short next bar open
strategy.lowerFailure: current low < min(previous N lows) and current close > prior channel low => long next bar open
strategy.ambiguousBar: if both upper and lower failures occur on the same bar, NO_TRADE
strategy.position: fixed 1 SOL; one open position at a time
strategy.intrabar: stop-first if stop and target are both touched in one candle; stop gap-through fills at adverse open; target fills at target price
strategy.exit: stop, target, or close of sixth holding candle
noTrade: outside SIDEWAYS_LOW context for conditional variant
insufficient bars to complete horizon within split

validation.selection: choose highest validation mean net R among lookback candidates with >=20 validation trades; if none qualify, use lookback 20 and record selection inconclusive
validation.untouchedTest: evaluate all three pre-registered lookbacks once on final test; do not select based on test
validation.multipleTesting: Holm correction across three test lookback variants
validation.uncertainty: 2,000 circular moving-block bootstrap replications, block length 5 trades, deterministic seed 20261105
validation.parameterNeighborhood: selected lookback and adjacent lookback variants must not show material negative OOS expectancy
validation.walkForwardRequirement: at least three non-overlapping OOS windows for OOS_VALIDATED; this single holdout alone cannot satisfy that requirement

costs.definition: fixed 15bp round-trip proxy covering taker fees, spread and slippage; not account-tier or historical fill calibrated
costs.funding: actual SOLUSDT historical funding rates at settlement timestamps; use funding-history markPrice when present, otherwise exact matching 4h candle open, otherwise trade entry price as a notional proxy; proxy counts are reported separately
costs.fundingIntervalObserved: 8h in current fundingInfo; historical interval changes checked from timestamp gaps
costs.fundingLimitations: Historical funding markPrice is blank for a material share of rows; entry-price proxy for non-4h-aligned settlement timestamps is approximate and prevents OOS_VALIDATED promotion from this single experiment.

baselines: same failed-breakout rules without context filter
SOL buy-and-hold price return over untouched test (reference only)
